_doc: How a station's automation plays (openspec/changes/bridge-stations section 3; coop-drill design 3). 'automation' holds a seat nobody holds, at the lower competence of bridge-stations: helm reacts in 1.5 s, holds heading and speed and never flies evasive; tactical reacts in 2.0 s and never fires missiles; science passive-scans at 1.5 times a manned scan's time; the captain's automation is auto-condition only (red alert when a hostile comes within red_within_m, normal normal_after_s after the last is beyond normal_beyond_m). Every automation acknowledges an order after its reaction_s. 'bot' is a bot client playing the seat like a decent player. reaction_s is how often it decides; rate_frac the share of the rate limit it turns at; standoff_m the range a hunting helm keeps; weave_deg and weave_period_s how it crosses the enemy's line of sight. 'orders' are the verbs the captain can send each station, [verb, icon] (bridge-stations 5: the verbs per station are data), in the console mockup's order; tools/ui/console_style.py --check holds the mockup's ORDER_VERBS to them. seats: getting up and sitting down, seconds (bridge-stations 6). bot_posts (coop-drill design 9): the stations a bot fills, most important first; a bot gets up for a more important station left empty, with nobody on the way, for reassign_s seconds.
